Wahrnehmen or Wahrmachen? German B2 Prefix Verb Practice

Choose wahrnehmen for perceiving or attending and wahrmachen for fulfilling a promise. Study German contextual meanings with translations and explained answers.

B2 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Understand the difference

Wahrnehmen can mean perceiving something or attending/keeping an appointment: ein Geräusch wahrnehmen, einen Termin wahrnehmen. Wahrmachen means making something come true or carrying it out: einen Traum wahrmachen, eine Ankündigung wahrmachen. Both separate in a main clause: nimmt wahr, macht wahr.

Common mistake to avoid

Einen Termin wahrnehmen means attending it, not making the appointment true. Learn the whole combination rather than translating wahr word for word.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Ich nehme im Flur ein leises Geräusch wahr.I perceive a quiet sound in the corridor.
Worked example 2Sie macht ihren Traum von einer eigenen Werkstatt wahr.She makes her dream of her own workshop come true.
Worked example 3Wir können den vereinbarten Termin wahrnehmen.We can attend the agreed appointment.
Worked example 4Er macht seine Ankündigung wahr und zieht aufs Land.He carries out his announced plan and moves to the countryside.

Practice: choose the right word

Choose wahrnehmen for the stated perception or appointment attendance and wahrmachen for making a dream or announced action real. Use the infinitive. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Mit geschlossenen Augen kann sie das Geräusch besser ___. (perceive)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: wahrnehmen

Ein Geräusch wahrnehmen describes sensory perception.

Question 2. Die Gruppe möchte ihren gemeinsamen Traum ___. (make come true)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: wahrmachen

Einen Traum wahrmachen means turning it into reality.

Question 3. Ich kann den Termin am Donnerstag ___. (attend)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: wahrnehmen

Einen Termin wahrnehmen is attending or keeping it.

Question 4. Sie will ihre Ankündigung nun ___. (carry out)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: wahrmachen

Eine Ankündigung wahrmachen means acting on what was announced.

Revise it so it sticks

Return to this lesson tomorrow and complete the four gaps without looking at the rule. Then write two of your own sentences using today's pattern. Check whether the subject, case and verb position match the explanation.
